On the topic of reconfiguring ACD could I quickly talk about this post? https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/for-an-acd-platform/24098

Re: Reconfiguring AllCoreDevs, if time permits, I'm happy to give a quick overview or answer questions about my [follow up proposal](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/community-consensus-fork-headliners-acd-working-groups/24088). 

Assuming we are OK to move forward with it, then I'd suggest the following timeline: 

* **May 22:** discussion about Glamsterdam **EL** fork focus, open call for tentative headliner features
* **May 29:** discussion about Glamsterdam **CL** fork focus, open call for tentative headliner features
* **June 5 & 19:** **EL** fork focus + headliner feature review 
* **June 12 & 26:** **CL** fork focus + headliner feature review 
* **July 3 & 10:** Finalize Glamsterdam fork focus & headliner
* **July 17:** open `PFI` submission for non-headliner EIPs for Glamsterdam
